claim_verdicts.evidence: Workflow syntax: "Each job runs in a runner environment specified by runs-on" and "jobs run in parallel by default." Using jobs: "Use jobs.<job_id>.needs to identify any jobs that must complete successfully before this job will run." "If a job fails or is skipped, all jobs that need it are skipped unless the jobs use a conditional expression that causes the job to continue."

"When the job begins, GitHub automatically provisions a new VM for that job." "When the job has finished, the VM is automatically decommissioned." "All steps in the job execute on the VM, allowing the steps in that job to share information using the runner's filesystem." ci.yml@stage-2: every job uses runs-on: ubuntu-24.04 (GitHub-hosted).

Workflow artifacts: "An artifact is a file or collection of files produced during a workflow run." Artifacts let you "persist data after a job has completed, and share that data with another job in the same workflow." Artifacts are for files "to use or view after a workflow run has ended". download-artifact README downloads a single artifact "by name or ID".
